title: 初二独白：巡回棋摊
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
timing_notice: 每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔和重播提示为本机编排
instruction: 听一段独白，完成全部五题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。独白两遍，听前25秒、听后25秒。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: My name is Oliver. Last spring I started a travelling chess stall with my aunt. She had taught me the game when I was nine. We noticed that children at the Sunday market often had to wait while their parents shopped. So we took three folding tables there and invited them to play. At first we asked each player for a pound, but many children did not have any money. Now everyone can play free. A local shop gives us old chess sets, and we repair them. We keep all the pieces in numbered cloth bags, because the cardboard boxes got wet in the rain. The stall runs every second Sunday, from ten until twelve. Beginners learn with my aunt, while I play short games with more experienced children. Next month we will add a fourth table. We are not planning a competition: we simply want more children to have a turn.

questions.stem: Who taught Oliver to play chess?
questions.rationale: A：未提叔叔；B：明确aunt taught me；C：未提父亲教棋

questions.stem: Why did they start the stall?
options: To give waiting children something to do.
questions.rationale: A：市场儿童等家长的观察促成；B：用旧棋具且免费玩；C：没有职业训练目标

questions.stem: How much does it cost to play now?
questions.rationale: A：早期收费；B：未说两镑；C：现在everyone can play free

questions.stem: What are the chess pieces kept in?
questions.rationale: A：没有塑料箱；B：明确编号布袋；C：没有纸信封

questions.stem: Why will they add another table?
questions.rationale: A：明确不打算比赛；B：没有售卖计划；C：让更多孩子轮到玩
